migration_partly_fail.message: Osa konto andmeid ei õnnestunud importida.

confirm_delete.message: Kas te olete kindel, et soovite selle konto kustutada? Seda toimingut ei saa tagasi võtta.

confirm_delete_all.message: Ma mõistan, et kõik minu andmed kustutatakse pöördumatult.
confirm_delete_all.description: Message that user is required to acknowledge before clearing all data.

delete_all_warning.message: See kustutab kõik teie andmed ja lähtestab Autentikaatori täielikult. Kustutatud andmeid ei saa taastada! Enne Autentikaatori lähtestamist peaksite kaaluma varukoopia loomist.

security_warning.message: Seda salasõna kasutatakse teie kontode krüpteerimiseks. Kui unustate salasõna, ei saa keegi teid aidata.

phrase_incorrect.message: Uut kontot ei saa lisada kuni kõik kontod on dekrüpteeritud. Palun sisestage enne jätkamist õige salasõna.

phrase_incorrect_export.message: Kontosid, mida ei olnud võimalik lahti krüpteerida, ei kaasata käesolevasse varukoopiasse.

clock_too_far_off.message: Ettevaatust! Teie kohalik kell liiga mööda, palun parandage enne jätkamist.

import_qr_images.description: Import qr images. Shown as add account method.

import_otp_urls.description: Import OTP URLs. Shown as add account method.

import_backup_qr_partly_failed.description: Import successful, but some QR image cannot be recognized.

import_backup_qr_in_batches.message: Saate importida varukoopiaid partiidena, valides mitu faili.
import_backup_qr_in_batches.description: You can select multiple image files to import backup in batches.

import_error_password.message: Varukoopiate importimiseks peate sisestama õige salasõna.
import_error_password.description: Error password warning when import backups.

local_passphrase_warning.message: Teie salasõna hoiustatakse kohapeal, palun muutke seda kohe turvalisuse menüüst.

popout.description: Make window turn into persistent popup

log_out.description: Sign out of 3rd party storage services

otp_unsupported_warn.description: Warning if using account that is not supported by standard backup format.

otp_backup_inform.message: Varukoopiaid saate importida ka mõnedest teisest rakendustest.

otp_backup_learn.description: learn more link on import page. Placed after otp_backup_inform

password_policy_default_hint.message: Teie salasõna ei vasta teie organisatsiooni turvanõuetele. Lisateabe saamiseks kontakteeruge oma administraatoriga.

advisor_insight_auto_lock_not_set.message: Enable auto-lock to protect your data.

advisor_insight_browser_sync_not_enabled.message: Browser sync is disabled. Enabling it allows accounts to be synced across browsers.

advisor_insight_auto_fill_not_enabled.message: Autofill can be enabled to automatically fill codes into websites.

advisor_insight_smart_filter_not_enabled.message: Enabling smart filter allows for quick access to accounts.

no_insight_available.message: No insights found, everything looks good!

no_entires.message: Pole kontosid, mida kuvada. Lisage enda esimene konto.

permission_required.message: This is a required permission and cannot be revoked.

permission_active_tab.message: Access to the current tab to scan QR codes.

permission_storage.message: Access to browser storage to store account data.

permission_scripting.message: Inject scripts into he current tab to scan QR codes and allow auto-fill to work.

permission_clipboard_write.message: Grants write-only access to the clipboard to copy codes to clipboard when you click on the account.

permission_unknown_permission.message: Unknown permission. If see this message, please send a bug report.

activate_auto_filter.message: Warning: Smart filter loosely matches the domain name to an account. Always verify that you are on the correct website before entering a code!

permission_github_api.message: GitHub API and private repository access

github_sync_info.message: Synchronize accounts through a private GitHub repository.

github_repo_requirement.message: Synchronization requires a private GitHub repository that is already initialized (non-empty).

github_remember_pat.message: Remember this PAT in this browser (local storage)

github_pat_storage.message: Remember PAT stores the token in this browser's local storage so you can sync after closing the popup. Uncheck it to keep the token only for this browser session.

github_pat_permissions.message: The personal access token needs Contents read and write access to the repository.

github_remember_password.message: Remember this sync password in this browser (local storage)

github_password_storage.message: Remember sync password stores the password and unlock key in this browser's local storage so you can sync again without retyping it. Uncheck it to keep them only for this browser session.

github_encryption_mandatory.message: Encryption is always required for synchronized data; there is no unencrypted mode.

github_password_warning.message: The sync password is stored only on this device when Remember sync password is checked. It is never uploaded to GitHub. Forgetting it on every device makes encrypted remote data unrecoverable.

github_encryption_explanation.message: Only encrypted operation contents are uploaded. Git metadata and permanent commit history remain visible to anyone with repository access. Entry deletions are permanent; Forget removes only this device's local sync history and does not delete the GitHub repository.

github_forget_confirm.message: This permanently deletes local sync history. Continue?

github_forget_confirm_again.message: Final confirmation: forget this repository and all local sync history?

github_status_token_required.message: A GitHub personal access token is required to continue. Enter a token with Contents read and write access.

github_status_needs_sync_password.message: Enter the sync password for this repository to unlock encryption.

github_status_rate_limited.message: GitHub API rate limit reached. Try again after the listed reset time.

github_status_branch_protected.message: The synchronized branch is protected and the update was rejected. Review branch protection rules.

github_status_history_rewritten.message: The remote history was rewritten. Sync stopped to avoid overwriting new entries. Check the documentation before continuing.

github_status_repository_changed.message: The remote repository identity changed. This device's sync link is out of date; disconnect and reconnect to verify the repository.

github_status_remote_missing.message: The synchronized branch or repository is missing. Confirm the repository exists and the sync branch still holds an encrypted config.

github_status_permission_required.message: GitHub API access is required. Grant the https://api.github.com/* permission to continue.

github_status_auth_failed.message: The GitHub token was rejected. Check the token and its Contents read/write permissions.

github_status_offline.message: GitHub is unreachable right now. Sync will retry automatically.

github_status_unsupported_server.message: The configured GitHub repository is not supported for sync (for example it is public). Use a private repository.

github_status_remote_corrupt.message: The remote sync data is malformed or inconsistent. The integrity of the repository could not be verified.

github_status_generic_error.message: GitHub sync failed. Check the repository, token, and network connection, then try again.

github_error_invalid_identity.message: Check the GitHub owner and repository names.

github_error_missing_token.message: A fine-grained personal access token is required.

github_error_password_mismatch.message: The sync password and its confirmation do not match.

github_error_create_password.message: Enter a new independent sync password to initialize this repository.

github_error_config_race.message: Another device initialized this repository with a different sync password. Enter the current sync password and try again.
